name: Jade Screen (Yupingfeng, Chinese herbal formula)
short: Add-on trial reviews: children's respiratory infections, 6 events vs 15, mainly gut upset, none serious; adult asthma, mild events in 2 studies; urticaria, adverse reactions no different.
text: Jade Screen is taken here to be the Yu Ping Feng (Yupingfeng) formula: a 2004 guinea-pig study names Gyokuheifu-san as the same formula as Jade Windscreen Powder in English and Yupingfeng-san in Chinese, and a 2000 mouse study gives Jade-Screen Decoction as the name of a modified Yu Ping Feng Tang; a 2026 review describes Yupingfeng powder as made of Astragalus membranaceus, Atractylodes macrocephala and Saposhnikovia divaricata. The human evidence comes from meta-analyses of trials in which it was added to usual treatment, in different preparations and conditions. In a 2017 meta-analysis of 16 randomized trials in chronic urticaria, the adverse-reaction rate with Jade Screen plus desloratadine did not differ significantly from desloratadine alone (P = 0.74). In a 2019 meta-analysis of 16 trials (1,788 cases) of Yupingfeng granules for recurrent respiratory tract infection (the abstract refers to children), 6 adverse events occurred in the groups given the granules with routine Western medicine and 15 in their control groups, mainly gastrointestinal reactions such as fatigue, nausea and diarrhoea that were tolerated or went away, and the difference was not statistically significant; none was reported in the 5 trials that compared the granules plus pidotimod (spelled pidomod in the abstract) with pidotimod alone; no serious adverse reaction was reported, and the authors describe the included studies as of low quality. In a 2026 meta-analysis of 20 trials (1,896 adults with asthma) of Yupingfeng powder, only two studies reported adverse events, which were mild (such as stomach discomfort and dry mouth), with no significant difference between groups and no serious adverse events; the authors note insufficient adverse event data. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
